changeSet.author: danna
changeSet.createView: SELECT l.id, l.titulo, l.isbn, l.precio, a.nombre || ' ' || a.apellido AS autor, e.nombre AS editorial, c.nombre AS categoria FROM libros l JOIN autores a ON a.id = l.id_autor JOIN editoriales e ON e.id = l.id_editorial JOIN categorias c ON c.id = l.id_categoria

changeSet.author: danna
changeSet.createView: SELECT v.id AS venta_id, cl.nombre || ' ' || cl.apellido AS cliente, em.nombre || ' ' || em.apellido AS empleado, v.fecha, v.total, v.estado FROM ventas v JOIN clientes cl ON cl.id = v.id_cliente JOIN empleados em ON em.id = v.id_empleado

changeSet.author: danna
changeSet.createView: SELECT l.titulo, i.stock, i.stock_minimo, p.nombre AS proveedor FROM inventario i JOIN libros l ON l.id = i.id_libro JOIN proveedores p ON p.id = i.id_proveedor WHERE i.stock <= i.stock_minimo
